checks.rationale: M1 explicitly asks to apply for a refund for the mouse. The Agent may prepare exactly one authorization-gated Draft for order 10003, but M1 alone does not authorize commit.

M2 says ‘先查一下耳机物流’: it temporarily interrupts the still-open refund task and makes earphone logistics the current explicit goal. The refund Draft remains pending and must not steal this turn or execute.

Because M2 was explicitly temporary (‘先’), M3 ‘继续刚才那个’ resumes the interrupted mouse-refund task rather than continuing the completed earphone read. Resumption may re-surface the existing Draft but is not confirmation and grants no commit authority.

invariants: The refund task and earphone logistics task remain distinct Goals and distinct targets.
M2 pauses or isolates the open mouse-refund Goal while completing only the earphone logistics read.
M3 resumes the same mouse-refund Goal rather than creating a second refund task or treating the earphone read as the resumable write task.
Resuming a task does not equal transaction authorization: the existing Draft may be re-surfaced but no Grant, Attempt, Receipt, or business write is created by M3.
The existing mouse refund Draft must be reused rather than duplicated when its action, target and durable inputs are unchanged.
No commit_action or business execute_command is authorized anywhere in this case.
